record.question:
Change the narration of the following sentences :
(a) He shouted at them to let him go.
(b) Macbeth said to his wife, “The time is near when I shall become king”.
(c) He said, “I take exercise in the morning”.
(d) I asked him if he would help me.
(e) She said to me, “You are fortunate”.
(f) She told me that I was the first.
(g) The teacher says to us, “You should never tell lies”. (10×1=10)
(h) The stranger asked me where I lived.
(i) The officer shouted, “Get back to work, all of you!”
(j) The traveller asked the boy if he could show him the way to the nearest police station.
